neighbours.label: the ends of a scale or ranking: 'at opposite ends of the spectrum', 'the low end of the market', 'the bottom of every ranking'; the physical bottom or end of a thing stays quiet
fire: The two parties stand at opposite ends of the political spectrum.
At the low end of the market, buyers care mostly about price.
This county sits near the bottom of every health ranking.
Workers at the bottom of the ladder saw no raise at all.
At the top end of the range, a single bottle costs a fortune.
These two species lie at opposite ends of the size scale.
Those at the bottom of the hierarchy have little say.
At the high end of the scale, salaries pass a million.
quiet: The two parties stood at opposite sides of the crowded room.
At the low table in the corner, buyers argued mostly about price.
This county lies near the mouth of a wide river.
Workers at the bottom of the mine saw no daylight at all.
At the top of the stairs, a single bulb lit the hall.
These two species live at the edge of the same lake.
Those at the back of the bus had little room.
At the far end of the street, children played football.
